body.message:
Please accept our apologies for the confusion and the delayed clarification. The previous message was sent automatically by our system.

Kindly note that the previously quoted rate is not applicable for daily bookings. The correct rate for a 1-week stay is AED 3,885.23.

If you are happy to proceed with this rate, please let us know, and we will send you the payment link to complete the payment and confirm your booking.
